authority.judge: Existing independent signed Spark judge with spark-rsi-mv#67 adaptive holdout controls. This file declares the protocol; it is not a second judge or eval authority.
authority.never_writable_by: Any trained, tuned or teacher arm. No arm may write the sealed split, the scorer, this preregistration or the result table.
authority.freeze_rule: status SCOPED may still change by reviewed commit. FROZEN requires every G revision pinned, the file digest signed by the judge and no candidate trained yet. After FROZEN any change is a new prereg_id; the old one is SUPERSEDED, never edited.

phase_definitions.preregistration_freeze: Judge signs the sha256 of this file with status FROZEN.
phase_definitions.seal_commitment: Judge draws the sealed seed and publishes only its commitment (see heldout.sealing).
phase_definitions.baseline_run: Every baseline arm runs on the calibration split; its predictions, scores and the B coder are signed and frozen before any candidate trains.
phase_definitions.candidate_training: Candidate and control arms learn only from the training split within the fixed budget in sample_size.training_budget.
phase_definitions.prediction_commit: Each arm receives sealed (prior_state, action) inputs from the judge once and returns predictions whose sha256 is signed before reveal.
phase_definitions.sealed_eval: Judge reveals actual next states and scores every committed prediction file once.
phase_definitions.analysis: Only the tests in metrics.confirmatory, with the Holm correction declared there.
phase_definitions.report: Separate status columns per claim in claims; negative and missing results are kept.

baseline_before_eval.rule: No candidate or control arm is trained or scored before every listed baseline has completed baseline_run and its signed calibration scores exist. A missing baseline makes every dependent comparison NOT_RUN, never PASS.

arms.description: Exact hand-written rule engine per environment family; no learning, no model. Also the #38 no-model deterministic operations arm.
Nearest checked procedure / stored verified transition from the training split, returned unchanged. No parameter update.
Unchanged declared-pretrained 0.8B Reflex + 2B student, prompted with the same state/action encoding. Weights never updated.
Unchanged Allen -> 27B route as currently qualified by Sovereign Core.
Unchanged Allen -> 35B route as currently qualified by Sovereign Core.
Per-sample 27B/35B candidates; an answer counts only after the independent verifier accepts it; teacher output is a hypothesis until verified. Every candidate call is counted.
#38 arm E: verified teacher-distilled SI student with Microforge. Distillation data are verified teacher outputs on the training split only.

PRIMARY. New world model initialized from a declared seed (no pretrained weights, no corpus) and trained only on verified training-split transitions {goal, prior_state_digest, action, predicted next state, actual next state, verification, cost, consent}. Saved verified skills must survive restart.
Same scratch model and budget as si_experience_only, plus 27B/35B advice admitted only after independent verification (licensed use only).
Same scratch model, seed and budget as si_experience_only, but next states permuted within (family, action type) so marginals stay and the transition signal is destroyed.

si_experience_only rebuilt from initialization after a signed revocation of a judge-chosen owner subset of training traces. Checks that revoked traces leave the training lineage and that performance on revoked-origin structure falls to the level of a model never given them.

environments.description: Seeded resettable grid/graph world with stochastic action outcomes; the simulator holds the exact next-state distribution.
environments.verifier: Simulator recomputes the exact transition distribution from (seed, state, action); no model judges.
environments.correct_if: Total variation distance between predicted and exact next-state distribution <= 0.10.

environments.description: Discrete-time dynamics with hidden constants (conservation, linear and nonlinear laws) in exact rational arithmetic.
environments.verifier: Exact rational recomputation of the next state.
environments.correct_if: Predicted next state equals the exact next state.

environments.description: State = .om source digest plus diagnostics; action = typed edit; next state = pinned seeded compiler result.
environments.verifier: Pinned seeded handwritten .om compiler (om_seeded_compiler in G) run by the judge.
environments.correct_if: Predicted diagnostics/result digest equals the compiler output digest.

environments.description: Typed microjob DAG (aien-protocols-mv#50) under declared resource limits; action = admit/schedule/cancel.
environments.verifier: Deterministic DAG simulator applying the canonical microjob ABI.
environments.correct_if: Predicted next DAG state digest equals the simulator digest.

environments.description: Multi-step objectives killed at a judge-chosen step and restarted from durable state; tests saved verified skill reuse after restart and no duplicated effects.
environments.verifier: Judge compares final effect log with the reference effect set; any duplicated or missing effect is incorrect.
environments.correct_if: Objective completes with exactly the reference effects after restart.

splits.training: Seeds under domain tag train; the only split any arm may learn from.
splits.validation: Seeds under domain tag validation; candidate early stopping and ICC estimation only.
splits.calibration: Seeds under domain tag calibration; baseline_run only.
splits.sealed: Seeds under domain tag sealed; scored once per arm.
splits.reserve: Two further sealed sets (reserve-1, reserve-2) of the sealed size, used only for a re-evaluation after any change.
splits.sealed_family: One extra environment family defined by the judge after freeze, disclosed only by hash commitment, for cross-family transfer (secondary).

sealing.mechanism: Judge draws a 256-bit seed after preregistration_freeze, publishes only sha256(domain_tag || seed), and generates sealed episodes on judge-owned storage under a separate OS user on a separate process tree. Candidate processes have no filesystem or network route to that storage. Arms receive only (prior_state, action) inputs through the judge, once, and commit sha256 of their prediction file before the judge reveals next states. Every read of sealed material is logged by the judge; a read by anything other than the judge scorer is a breach.
sealing.collision_rule: Episodes whose state digest appears in more than one split are removed from training, never from sealed.
sealing.breach_action: Void the affected sealed set (INCONCLUSIVE), keep the record, regenerate from the next reserve.

e2.definition: Binary per sealed episode using the environment correct_if rule; paired across arms on identical episodes.
e2.test: Exact conditional McNemar (one-sided), stratified by family for reporting.

e1.definition: Binary per objective: completed, independently verified correct and authorized, with no silent context truncation.

confirmatory.correction: Holm within each study; planning used Bonferroni (conservative).

cost_accounting.throughput: Independently verified objectives/sec with p50/p95 completion and TTFT; NOT_MEASURED unless instrumented on a scheduled uncontended run.
cost_accounting.missing_counter_rule: A counter that was not measured is NOT_MEASURED, never zero.
cost_accounting.reuse_break_even: Immutable preparation reused n times wins only when (n-1)P > nH + V with P, H, V measured; otherwise NOT_MEASURED.

sample_size.computed_with: Wolfram Language evaluator 2026-10-24: approximate n by Connor (1987) normal formula, then exact power of the conditional binomial McNemar test, summed over the binomial number of discordant pairs, increasing n until power >= target.

studies.sensitivity: At ICC 0.10 the design effect is 2.1, effective n 285 and exact power 0.7825; see stopping_rules icc_check.
The issue minimum of 30 objectives has exact power 0.2354 for this effect; 30 objectives is a pilot, not a confirmatory test.

sample_size.training_budget: Equal for every learning arm: the same training-split transitions, the same number of optimizer steps and the same parameter count for scratch arms; budget fixed at FROZEN from validation-split pilot only.

stopping_rules.action: Scoring happens once, after all arms commit predictions. No interim efficacy or futility look at sealed data, no optional stopping, no adding episodes after reveal.

stopping_rules.trigger: Before FROZEN, the ICC estimated on the validation split exceeds the assumed value.
stopping_rules.action: Increase tasks_planned until effective_n_planned >= exact_min_effective_n, recompute in Wolfram, then freeze. Never after freeze.

stopping_rules.trigger: Any non-judge access to sealed material, or a prediction commitment missing before reveal.
stopping_rules.action: Void that sealed set as INCONCLUSIVE, keep the record, continue only on the next reserve.
Campaign ends INCONCLUSIVE; a new campaign needs a new prereg_id.

stopping_rules.trigger: An arm exceeds any metrics.safety_ceilings value.
stopping_rules.action: That arm is FAIL for promotion regardless of accuracy; scoring of the other arms continues.

stopping_rules.trigger: A learning arm reaches the fixed training budget.
stopping_rules.action: Training stops; early stopping may use the validation split only.

stopping_rules.trigger: An arm with requires_gpu true has no scheduled uncontended GPU window and signed receipt.
stopping_rules.action: That arm and every comparison using it are NOT_RUN or BLOCKED, never estimated.

turing_profile.applies_to: Learned predictive explanatory gain of candidate arms on D only; not service price, a single answer or a per-job metric.

B.description: Rules engine predictions coded under P; frozen at baseline_run.

D.description: Sealed transitions of heldout.splits.sealed, coded under P after reveal.

background.pin_basis: aien-dev/omega-mv main HEAD on 2026-10-24 (merge of PR #701), contains seed/; verified with git ls-remote and a local checkout. Re-pin before FROZEN if the compiler changes.
aien-dev/aien-train main HEAD on 2026-10-24 (skeleton, plan, thesis); verified with git ls-remote and a local checkout. The T2 learner (aien-train#19) is not on main yet; re-pin before FROZEN.

P.encoding: Canonical state/action/next-state serialization of the environment family, arithmetic-coded by reference_coder with fixed 32-bit precision; L(M|G) is the reference-coded size of the model checkpoint plus its code given G.
P.sampling: All sealed episodes, no subsampling; seeds as in heldout.
P.energy: Joules only from an instrumented, reconciled measurement; otherwise NOT_MEASURED.
P.statistical_test: Per-episode paired code-length differences; one-sided sign-flip permutation test with 100000 permutations at alpha 0.05, reported beside but separate from metrics.confirmatory.

T_ideal.definition: Code lengths as sum of -log2 of the probability each model assigns to the actual next state, plus ideal L(M|G).

T_real.definition: Actual reference_coder output bits for B and M, valid only after the H1 reference coder round-trip (decode reproduces the exact input bytes).

energy.reconciliation: Required before any T/J: measured joules reconciled against an independent meter for the same interval.

tj.reason: No energy instrument is declared and no joules are measured; T/J is not reported.

turing_profile.attribution: One joint gain under one profile is counted once; it is never minted per contributor. Scientific T, measured utility and spendable credits are separate columns.

claim_rules: A scientific negative result is acceptable research but gives no performance or deployment promotion.
Never claim SI superiority without positive sealed quality and full-cost evidence.
Simulated time or energy is never reported as measured.
Hardware and two-real-owner results count only when separately consented and signed.
